messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Gomez <sara@brightbridge.co>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: 3-track candidate daymap and quick asks (Ethan Rhodes)

Hi Sara + team,

Thanks for sending Ethan's availability. He can do the week of Nov 29 — I'm drafting a compact 3-track virtual day (3 x 45min deep dives + 30min debrief). Quick asks before I lock invites:

- Confirm Ethan prefers morning PT or afternoon PT windows (we have interviewers split across PST/EST).
- Any non-negotiable calendar blocks?
- Is there anything on his profile I should highlight for the interviewers (projects / code sample to review)?

Planned sequencing (draft):
1) Systems & Architecture (45m) — technical lead + infra
2) Product & Design sense (45m) — PM + design partner
3) Deep implementation exercise (45m) — an embedded pairing task + short clarifying follow-up

Debrief: 30m immediately after the three sessions with 2 debrief stewards (one tech, one product) to capture notes and hire/no-hire rubrics.

I've attached Ethan's candidate profile for quick reference. If this works I'll push calendar invites with staggered breaks and a single Zoom link per block.

Thanks,
Marissa

--

Senior Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
